mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pickup_record (parcel_id, pickup_type, owner_id, picker_id, auth_id, staff_id, station_id) VALUES (#{parcelId}, #{pickupType}, #{ownerId}, #{pickerId}, #{authId}, #{staffId}, #{stationId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pickup_record WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY picked_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
